description: Non material amendment to planning permission 26/00660 (Variation of condition 2 (compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission 13/05535 (Redevelopment of lower ground floor in garden, excavation of two basement levels, replacement of glass pavilion, re-landscaping of rear garden and associated alterations) to allow for internal and external alterations to the approved scheme including reconfigured layouts, depths, and floor areas at basement levels 1,2, and 3, alterations to lightwells and introduction of a new lightwell; removal of the secondary staircase in the garden pavilion and the bridge over the rear lightwell and introduction of new york stone stairs at ground floor level; and changes to the lightwell and removal of the bridge at first floor level.) to remove the word 'glass' from the description above; i.e. (Variation of condition 2 (compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission 13/05535 (Redevelopment of lower ground floor in garden, excavation of two basement levels, replacement of pavilion, re-landscaping of rear garden and associated alterations) to allow for internal and external alterations to the approved scheme including reconfigured layouts, depths, and floor areas at basement levels 1,2, and 3, alterations to lightwells and introduction of a new lightwell; removal of the secondary staircase in the garden pavilion and the bridge over the rear lightwell and introduction of new york stone stairs at ground floor level; and changes to the lightwell and removal of the bridge at first floor level.)
